text_block_list.text:
I had come to the cafeteria with Rice 
Shower to have lunch.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A ripe apple triangle pie...! Looks 
delicious...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You know... in world fairy tales, the ones 
who eat their fill are usually the 
villains...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice is eating a lot too... At this 
rate... Rice will become a villain...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Still... I'll do my best. Rice doesn't 
want to become the villain...!

Afterward, Rice Shower desperately began 
restricting how much she ate...
